Name: Simple Nightfall
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#F2C879]🌙 Simple Nightfall[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/color][/heading]

[b]PC 1.8 • Android 1.8 • Co-op requires 1.8+ on every player[/b]

Choose a [b]2–6 AM bedtime[/b], add reminders, and customize the night with optional [b]Neutral Black lighting[/b], adjustable brightness and a gradual dawn.

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🌌 Bedtime & Reminders[/color][/heading]

Choose when the day ends in [b]10-minute steps[/b]; the default is [b]6 AM[/b]. Bedtime changes made during a day apply the following day.

Receive reminders [b]60, 30 and/or 10 minutes[/b] before your cutoff, using text, sound, both or neither. An optional indicator beneath the clock shows your bedtime, with a final-hour-only option and adjustable vertical position.

[heading][color=#9ACAF7]🤝 PC & Android Multiplayer — Experimental[/color][/heading]

The [b]host chooses the bedtime, reminders, night lighting, dawn and minimum-sleep rules[/b]. Farmhands follow those rules, including when joining late or reconnecting. Bedtime changes still apply the following day.

[b]Every player must install Nightfall 1.8 or newer: the PC edition on PC, or the Android edition on Android.[/b] Host-only installation and split-screen are not supported. Farmhands can adjust their own bedtime HUD visibility and position; their personal gameplay configuration is kept for single-player.

[b]Testing status:[/b] controlled native-game and SMAPI-message checks have passed. A real connected multiplayer session and Android-device play have not yet been verified. Android 1.8 uses the same host-rule protocol; desktop checks include the recovered Android 1.6.15.3 clock instructions and backup-load guard. Nightfall does not enable the game’s hidden co-op menu or configure networking. Use compatible game/SMAPI versions across players.

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🌑 Night Lighting[/color][/heading]

Choose [b]Original[/b] or [b]Neutral Black[/b]. Neutral Black removes the normal blue night cast and offers [b]1x–4x darkness[/b], while lamps illuminate their surroundings. During ordinary rainy nights it also removes the rain colour casts.

[b]Night brightness[/b] ranges from [b]0–100%[/b] in 5% steps. Select [b]Neutral Black[/b], then raise Night brightness for clearer scenery without the blue night cast. [b]0%[/b] keeps the existing darkness; [b]100%[/b] removes ambient night darkening. Native lamp lighting is retained.

Original is the default; Neutral Black uses [b]2x strength[/b] unless you change it. Night brightness defaults to [b]0%[/b]. The neutral effect excludes interiors, events, green rain, maps that ignore outdoor lighting, and clear-weather maps using custom nonwhite ambient lighting.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53862/53862-1792520157-1343167335.png[/img][/center]

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🌅 Dawn[/color][/heading]

Enable [b]Pre-dawn lighting[/b] to brighten the world gradually toward [b]6 AM[/b]. Set its duration from [b]30–240 game minutes[/b]; the default two-hour fade runs from [b]4 AM to 6 AM[/b] and follows the game clock and pauses. Rain’s morning lighting returns gradually during the fade.

Dawn is enabled by default for new configurations. Existing explicit On/Off choices remain. An earlier bedtime can end the day before the fade finishes.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53862/53862-1792520158-93772206.png[/img][/center]

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]💤 Minimum Sleep[/color][/heading]

Optionally require [b]1–8 hours of sleep before 6 AM[/b], default [b]4 hours[/b]. Below the threshold, native overnight health and energy cannot increase, including native level-up and profession refills. This option is [b]off by default[/b].

[heading][color=#9ACAF7]⚙️ Settings & Requirements[/color][/heading]

Use optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or edit [b]config.json[/b] while the game is closed. [b]Enable Nightfall[/b] is available from the title screen; other options can be adjusted in-game. Bedtime changes still apply the following day.

[b]PC:[/b] Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15+[/b] and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.0+[/b].
[b]Android:[/b] game [b]1.6.15.3[/b] and a compatible [b]Android SMAPI 4.0+ port[/b]. Install the Android download for that setup.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53862/53862-1792520165-253906384.png[/img][/center]

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]📦 Installing & Updating[/color][/heading]

Download the [b]PC or Android edition[/b], never both. Extract [b]SimpleNightfall[/b] into [b]Mods[/b]. Close the game before updating, replace the supplied files and keep your existing [b]config.json[/b]. Both editions use the same mod identity.

The Android edition supports after-2-AM single-player backup and emergency loading. The native loading advance still applies: a [b]3:30 AM backup resumes at 3:40 AM[/b]. It cannot restore progress already lost before the backup.

[heading][color=#9ACAF7]🤝 Compatibility[/color][/heading]

Experimental PC and Android co-op uses the host’s rules and requires Nightfall 1.8+ on every player. [b]Split-screen is unsupported.[/b] Use one bedtime extension: Nightfall stays inactive if [b]Night Owl, Night Owl Plus or Beyond Bedtime[/b] is detected.

Native pass-out costs, exhaustion, late-sleep penalties and fish availability rules still apply. Other mods may add their own clock or coloured-lighting effects.

Run [b]nightfall_status[/b] in the SMAPI console to see the clock state, today’s and next day’s cutoffs, night-lighting state, strength, brightness, synchronization state and dawn setting. If optional darkness hooks cannot load, the status explains why and the clock remains available.

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]🌍 Languages & Credits[/color][/heading]

English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Italian and Hungarian.

Requested by [b]LosstarottArt[/b]. Night brightness suggested by [b]miramagi[/b]. Gallery previews use composed native desktop renders, not played-save captures.

[heading][color=#F2C879]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/color][/heading]

Please share reports and suggestions on this mod’s page.

[b]For bugs:[/b] include the mod version and edition, game/SMAPI versions and platform, what happened versus what you expected, steps to reproduce, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url]. Add a screenshot or short video when helpful.

[b]For suggestions:[/b] explain what you would like changed or added and how it would help.
